units.source_text: 左方的人说：“这古代故事与赫映姬本人一样不朽。

en.t: The people on the left said, "This ancient tale is as immortal as Lady Kaguya herself.

units.source_text: 情节虽然并无风趣，但其主角赫映姬不染浊世尘垢，怀抱清高之志，

en.t: Although the plot has little charm, its heroine, Lady Kaguya, remains unstained by the dust and defilement of this impure world and cherishes a noble aspiration,

units.source_text: 终于升入月宫，足见宿缘非浅。

en.t: until at last she ascends to the palace of the moon, which clearly shows that her destined bond from past lives was far from shallow.

units.source_text: 这原是神明治世时节的故事，我等世俗女子，真乃望尘莫及了。”

en.t: This was originally a story from the age when the gods ruled the world; for worldly women like us, it is truly far beyond our reach."
